Subject: Post-discovery: ML/Infra sync & next steps

Hi Liam — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan:

Recap (very high level):
- Use case: low-latency, per-request personalization for analytics queries (mix of short prompts and long-context reranks).
- Model families under consideration: local fine-tuned Llama-3 variants and a smaller reranker model for 1-shot signals.
- Target SLO: p95 generation latency <= 400ms for 4k token requests; batchable endpoints acceptable for background workloads.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 + customer-managed KMS required for key material; data residency in us-west.
- Traffic profile: expected spike to ~200 rps peak during business hours; long tail of 5–10k token generation jobs per day.

Proposal / next step: schedule a 60–90 minute ML + Infrastructure deep-dive where our ML infra engineer will walk through serving architecture, sizing, and automated scaling options. Goal: align on runbook, sizing assumptions, and outstanding blockers so BrightMetrics can decide on Dedicated vs Hosted routing.

Suggested windows (PT):
- Mon Mar 30, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Tue Mar 31, 14:00–15:30 PT

Proposed agenda (we can tweak):
1) Introductions & goals (5–10m)
2) Production traffic & perf targets (10m)
3) Model runtime considerations (quantization, KV cache, token-level cost) (20m)
4) Sizing & capacity planning (batching, autoscaling policies) (20m)
5) Security, data flow, and KMS options (10m)
6) Open questions / next steps (10–15m)

Please confirm which window works for you and who from BrightMetrics will attend (ML lead, SRE, procurement if they want to join). I’ll CC our ML infra lead and a solutions architect once we lock a time and share a short agenda + pre-reads.

Attached: draft agenda stub.

Thanks — talk soon.
